notes: Partial run. WebFetch only opened URLs that surfaced in search results (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED otherwise), and search was dominated by AgendaPro/aggregators, so only clinics whose own site could be opened were added. No duty rota or animal poison line found: CITUC (UC) page lists toxicological emergencies +56 2 2635 3800 but does not mention animals, so no poison_line entry. Not reachable: veterinaria.uchile.cl, facultades.unab.cl (redirect), cituc.uc.cl, vet24chile.cl (robots), veterinariantakari.cl (robots), nuevadogtoraflaca.cl (robots), hospitalveterinariocde.cl (robots), centrovetvalpo.cl (robots), hospitalveterinariotalcahuano.skedu.com (error), vanguardiavet.cl (account suspended), cruzazul.cl (redirect loop). Inmevet (Maipú/Ñuñoa, advertises 24/7) and vet24chile.cl, Hospital Veterinario CDE, Centro Médico Veterinario Valparaíso, Hospital Veterinario Talcahuano (Villa Animal), Cedivet / SOS Vet / Hospital Veterinario Concepción (Concepción), Hospital Veterinario Hualpén, Nueva Dogtora Flaca (Antofagasta), Antakari (La Serena) are candidates still to confirm from reachable own pages. Nothing usable found for Iquique, Arica (private), Osorno, Puerto Varas, Pucón, Coquimbo, Antofagasta 24 h beyond aggregators. Royal Pets (La Serena) has only title/meta evidence for 24/7 and no address/phone: verify. Vet24 Ñuñoa publishes a 51 (La Serena) area-code phone: verify. Follow-up run 2026-11-10: about 30 WebSearch queries (Concepción/Talcahuano/Hualpén, Iquique, Antofagasta, Osorno, Pucón/Puerto Varas, Coquimbo/La Serena, Punta Arenas, municipal vet centres, Santo Tomás/San Sebastián hospitals, and each named candidate) returned only aggregators (AgendaPro, infoisinfo, mercantil, cronoshare, clinic-directory sites), job boards and press; no clinic's own site or official body page surfaced, so WebFetch could not be used on one and no new entry was added. Only official page opened: vet.udec.cl/sitio/contacto/ (lists Clínica Club Hípico, Colón 7510, Hualpén, without phone or hours; not enough for an entry). Still unconfirmed: Inmevet, Hospital Veterinario CDE, Centro Médico Veterinario Valparaíso, Villa Animal Talcahuano, Cedivet / SOS Vet / Hospital Veterinario Concepción, Skinvet (San Pedro de la Paz), Hualpén hospital, Nueva Dogtora Flaca, Antakari, Royal Pets / Exoplanet / Animal House (La Serena), Animaland (Villa Alemana), Iquique, Osorno, Pucón, Puerto Varas, Punta Arenas beyond Santa Sofía. Needs a run that can reach these sites directly or from a human-supplied URL list.
